en: An old Spanish postal card with cream paper and red printing. At the top it reads "TARJETA POSTAL" with a red Spanish royal coat of arms on the left and a printed red stamp on the right showing a crowned portrait and the word "ESPAÑA CORREO" with the value "10 Cs". A serial number "T.531963" appears in black at the top left. The address side is filled with elegant handwritten script in Spanish, with lines crossed out in blue pencil. At the bottom left, small red printed text indicates only the address should be written on this side. The card is lightly foxed and aged.
